On the first beat his raised finger jabs up at the racing paper twice; on the next his other glove rubs the money sign hard at the lens; then both arms snap wide, palms down; then a big sarcastic shrug, palms up; then the finger jabs up again. Hands stay below and beside his masked face. The pressman keeps reading, bored. Mask, suit and gloves unchanged. SFX: rotary presses clattering, paper hissing.
